import json, re, subprocess, time
from datetime import datetime

def clean_wiki(text):
    text = re.sub(r'<ref[^>]*>.*?</ref>', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL)
    text = re.sub(r'<ref[^/]*/>', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'<ref[^>]*>', '', text)
    prev = None
    while prev != text:
        prev = text
        text = re.sub(r'\{\{[^{}]*\}\}', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\[\[(?:[^|\]]*\|)?([^\]]*)\]\]', r'\1', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\[https?://\S+\s+([^\]]*)\]', r'\1', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\[https?://\S*\]', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r"'''?", '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
    return text

def extract_cells_from_row(row_text):
    cells = []
    row_text = row_text.replace('||', '\n__CELLSEP__')
    lines = row_text.split('\n')
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('__CELLSEP__'):
            cell = line[len('__CELLSEP__'):].strip()
            if cell:
                cells.append(cell)
        elif line.startswith('! scope="row"'):
            match = re.search(r'\|\s*(.*)', line)
            if match:
                cells.append(match.group(1).strip())
        elif line.startswith('|') and not line.startswith('|-') and not line.startswith('|+'):
            cell = line[1:].strip()
            if cell:
                cells.append(cell)
    return cells

def parse_cell_value(cell):
    rs = re.search(r'rowspan\s*=\s*"?(\d+)"?', cell)
    cs = re.search(r'colspan\s*=\s*"?(\d+)"?', cell)
    rowspan = int(rs.group(1)) if rs else 1
    colspan = int(cs.group(1)) if cs else 1
    match = re.search(r'\|\s*(.*)', cell, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        return rowspan, colspan, match.group(1).strip()
    return 1, 1, cell
